## #419: verification

1. The reported disappearance of the `.rlib` divergence with `--remap-path-prefix` strongly supports embedded source paths as the cause. The implementation compares exact file digests, and does not distinguish path-only changes from other byte differences. Neither the warning nor passing tests proves that paths were the only difference. The user's actual artifacts were not available for comparison.
2. Stderr is compared **after** restoring placeholders into the current checkout's spelling, not before rewriting. See [Rust restore](https://github.com/jdx/mr-boxington/blob/b7d9d34171a776189e84e5ebe98c29dce4d8d4a8/crates/mbx/src/rustc.rs#L2138-L2145) and [comparison](https://github.com/jdx/mr-boxington/blob/b7d9d34171a776189e84e5ebe98c29dce4d8d4a8/crates/mbx/src/rustc.rs#L2339-L2370). It still compares raw bytes, so unmodeled path spellings, diagnostic ordering/content, or another difference remain possible. The current warning cannot identify the compilation or show its differing bytes. Nearby Cargo `Compiling` lines are not reliable attribution in a parallel build.
3. Divergences count **compilations**, not output files. Each comparison returns its first mismatch and records once. The session deduplicates warnings by `(severity, entire message)`. Two identical `standard error differs` messages therefore print once but increment divergences twice. This explains the reported shape: 3 divergences / 2 warnings before remapping, 2 divergences / 1 warning afterward. Exact affected units remain unknown. Also, `374 verified, 3 diverged` means 374 comparisons including the 3 divergences, not 377 total. See [counting](https://github.com/jdx/mr-boxington/blob/b7d9d34171a776189e84e5ebe98c29dce4d8d4a8/crates/mbx-cache-core/src/agent.rs#L1574-L1582) and [deduplication](https://github.com/jdx/mr-boxington/blob/b7d9d34171a776189e84e5ebe98c29dce4d8d4a8/crates/mbx-cache-core/src/agent.rs#L2019-L2049). The same deduplication exists in v1.10.0.
4. Workspace remapping is intentionally modeled: the [existing regression test](https://github.com/jdx/mr-boxington/blob/b7d9d34171a776189e84e5ebe98c29dce4d8d4a8/crates/mbx-cache-rustc/src/rustc_cache_tests.rs#L1195-L1213) checks that the source side becomes `${workspace}` while the destination `/src` stays stable.
